end.summary:
- Discussed Diwali, Pongal, and Makar Sankranti.
- Connected harvest festivals with crops becoming ready to cut.
- Kavya corrected the idea that festival dates are random.
- Identified regional differences in Diwali celebrations, including fireworks and lamps.
- Described Pongal as involving new rice and sweet pongal; regional celebration details needed more practice.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised linking harvest festivals to the time when crops are ready and explained that festivals may be celebrated differently in different regions. They first said festival dates were random, then corrected this by connecting April and wheat harvest with crops being ready to cut and giving thanks. At home, ask Kavya to describe one local festival using food, clothes, decorations, and flowers.
